text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан is on today, right? I really
want to
see that powerful running of
hers!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
I know, right? She really is a beast!
Ahhh, I'm so
glad to be alive right now
to witness her!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text:
But it seems like Маяно Топ Ган is
running as
well! I hear people are
expecting big things from
her!
text_block_list.name: Spectator C

text_block_list.text:
I think being able to come to this Arima
Kinen is
the proudest moment of my life!
text_block_list.name: Spectator D

text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. The crowd appears quite
animated this
year.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Is it in anticipation of the champion's
triumphant
return? Or perhaps the
appearance of a rising
hero that would
defeat her?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I have high hopes for you, Нарита Брайан.
And that
strength of yours.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
"Is this tide of change unstoppable?"

"Who will face Brian, the strongest
racer?"
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
This year's not even over. Even if they
claim I'm
the strongest, it doesn't mean
anything.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list:
Still, I completely understand wanting to call
you that.

text_block_list.text: Heh...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Well, if that's the case, just remember
you're the
one who made me the
strongest.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm off.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Time to conquer once more and take the
final
crown of the Senior Autumn Triple
Crown.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Expect nothing short of victory from me!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...You're here.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Sis.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I managed to pull it off in
time and run
in the Arima Kinen with
you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Allow me to officially challenge you,
and—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be the one to beat Brian!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Krrrsh! Do you copy?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Heh. This is Маяно Топ Ган, the
winner of this
year's Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
She's still young, but if you
underestimate her,
she'll knock you off
your feet.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Huh... I see.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Well then, both of you listen up!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Come at me like you mean it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Of course!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Copy that! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
